answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by locking a saffron-priced escrow that unlocks only after a multi-day karst of sparse peer checks. Each check injects a one-shot ripple challenge whose timing and wording must match the agent's live decision path. Clones that share a model collide on ripple fingerprints and forfeit every linked escrow; an attacker must fund N saffron escrows and keep N independent minds online through the full karst window, so farm scale burns capital before any payout.
